summary: Iteration 81 — Recipe categories restructure, 6 new recipes, Recipe Generator (PRO), Community auto-translation, Shop 'Pasticceria' bundle, i18n ES. BACKEND 11/11 pytest passed (/app/backend/tests/test_iter81_gen_community.py): POST /api/recipes/generate with poolish/biga/lm returns readable localized title, correct baker's-percentage math (water = hydration% of total flour, salt ~2%, poolish 30% flour @100% hyd, biga 40% @45%, LM 25%, extras grams, sum of parts == total_weight +/-1%), hydration clamped to 100, AI procedure >200 chars in ES/IT/DE, non-PRO user -> 403, unauth -> 401. Community: POST /api/community/posts + /comments return populated text_de/text_en/text_es (real translations, persisted, no _id leak); test posts deleted. Recipes: all 6 new recipes exist with menu_category viennoiserie (5) / pane (Pane di Cristallo), procedure + name/procedure _de/_en/_es populated; no croissant/cornetto/panettone/stollen/danish filed under pane/panini. Bundle: /api/recipes/bundle-checkout 'pasticceria' -> 200 Stripe session (not completed), invalid bundle -> 400. FRONTEND (mobile 390x844, admin login): recipe tab shows exactly the 5 macro folders (Basi & Lieviti 6, Pasticceria Lievitata & Viennoiserie 23, Pane & Panificati 47, Focacce 12, Snack 11); all new recipes open with INGREDIENTI + PROCEDIMENTO and in-dialog language switch renders ES/DE/EN correctly; PANE folder (47) has zero viennoiserie leaks. Generator UI: capo-quicklink-generatore opens recipe-generator, form + slider (78%) + extras + weight 1500 -> gen-result with correct doses and full Italian procedure (4.4k chars). Shop shows 'Pasticceria Lievitata & Viennoiserie' €50, legacy 'panettoni' bundle gone, click fires bundle-checkout 200. Community in ES renders Spanish translation only. CRITICAL: 'Aprende' (Impara) tab is a BLANK/crashed screen when lang=es.

minor.issue: extra_ingredients[].name has no _de/_en/_es variants; in ES/DE/EN recipe detail uncommon ingredient names stay Italian (e.g. Stollen in ES: 'Arancia e cedro canditi a cubetti', 'Mandorle tritate', 'Marzapane (inserto centrale)', 'Spezie: cardamomo, cannella...', 'Latte intero'). Only dictionary-matched names get translated.

ui_bugs.issue: White/blank screen with runtime error when lang=es: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading freeCourses)'. /app/frontend/src/data/content.js has only it/de/en keys, so content['es'] is undefined at Beginners.jsx:347. Tab body length = 0. IT/DE/EN work fine.

8 direct content[lang] usages without fallback (Beginners.jsx, CoursesPanel.jsx, NewsPage.jsx, Encyclopedia.jsx, Mikilab.jsx, MaestroSaTutto.jsx x3) — same crash risk for lang=es; needs an es block in data/content.js plus `content[lang] || content.it` guard.
With lang=es the encyclopedia content renders entirely in Italian (Poolish/Lievito Madre entries) — untranslated fallback.

issues: New recipes (Cornetti all'Italiana, Croissant Classici, Croissant Tradizionali, Danish Pastry, Stollen) have no image_url: cards show a grey chef-hat placeholder while all legacy recipes have photos
Floating 'Radio' bubble (bottom-left) overlaps the ingredient rows / result table on 390px width, partially hiding a line of text

action_items: CRITICAL: add an `es` block to /app/frontend/src/data/content.js (freeCourses, news, encyclopedia, lievitoMadre, promptSuggestions, youtubeVideos) and guard all content[lang] reads with `content[lang] || content.it` — the Aprende tab is currently a blank crashed screen in Spanish
Translate the Enciclopedia content for ES (currently Italian fallback)
Add name_de/name_en/name_es (or a wider translation map) for extra_ingredients so ES/DE/EN recipe ingredient lists are fully localized
Add images (image_url) for the 5 new viennoiserie recipes
Adjust the floating Radio bubble z-index/offset so it doesn't cover content on mobile
critical_code_review_comments: data/content.js is keyed by language with no ES entry while LangContext allows 'es' — any component doing content[lang].X throws. Introduce a helper `getContent(lang)` returning `content[lang] ?? content.it` and use it everywhere (8 call sites).
server.py is 4625 lines — should be split into routers (recipes, community, payments, capo) for maintainability.

/api/recipes/generate silently returns procedure:'' if EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is missing or LLM fails; frontend then shows an empty procedure block. Return a warning flag or 502 so the UI can show an error state.

rca_of_the_issue: Aprende ES blank screen: LangProvider accepts 'es' but /app/frontend/src/data/content.js only defines it/de/en. Beginners.jsx:347 does `content[lang].freeCourses` -> TypeError on undefined, the React error boundary/dev overlay replaces the whole tab (inner_text length 0). Reproduce: localStorage.setItem('mikilab_lang','es'), login, click [data-testid='nav-tab-impara']. Mitigation: add es content + null-safe access.
